about: Liveries whose palette is swapped as they are baked (tools/fleet/recolor.mjs; LS-252). A pair here keeps its own paint, its titles, doors, windows and registration, its colours replaced: each pixel read as a blend of two of `from` (white and black always among them) and drawn as the same blend of `to`. The flat colours the kit keeps (cowl, belly, winglet) are swapped the same way.

b737-700|SWA.why: F-35 (LS-251, 25 Nov): the library's b737-southwest paints the Heart livery in pure RGB; the targets are the medians of the same colours on its 737-800's bake (b738-southwest): Bold Blue, Warm Red, Sunrise Yellow
